summary: Verified analysis.tsx URI-guard follow-up fix. Scenario A (Treesh Music → 'Bankrupt (Freestyle)' → Normal → play-generated-chart-button): stays on /analysis and renders the error card with analysis-retry-button, analysis-edit-button, and analysis-back-button; game screen is NOT reached. Scenario B (regression, On this device → 'Voco Warmup' → Easy → play-generated-chart-button): builds chart and enters /game with the 3-2-1 countdown/gameplay UI as before. Pre-existing RN-web console warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver missing) unchanged and non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"', '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow"', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', and 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' on web. Pre-existing, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: analysis.tsx#play() now guards with `if (!selectedSong.uri) { setPhase('error'); return; }` before generateFor/navigation — correctly matches game.tsx's uri requirement. retry() also re-guards uri before re-running analyzeAudio. Looks clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URI-guard verified on preview where treesh.app catalog is CORS-blocked (treesh songs load from fallback without uri). song-card testID pattern is `song-card-{id}` (e.g., song-card-bankrupt, song-card-neon-warmup). Difficulty chips: `difficulty-{easy|normal|hard|expert|custom}-chip`. Play CTA: `play-generated-chart-button`. Error-card CTAs: analysis-retry-button, analysis-edit-button, analysis-back-button.
rca_of_issue: Prior iteration_5 gap fixed by adding `if (!selectedSong.uri) { setPhase('error'); return; }` at the top of analysis.tsx#play(). Confirmed: Treesh 'Bankrupt (Freestyle)' now surfaces the analysis error card instead of navigating to /game where game.tsx's own uri guard rendered the 'Chart not ready — Build a chart' dead-end. Regression run on Voco Warmup (built-in, valid uri) still enters gameplay successfully.
